quarterly_data.quarter: Zhen Ding press release: Zhen Ding Priced US$800 Million Offering of Overseas (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Financing: Zhen Ding priced its sixth unsecured overseas convertible bond issuance on September 22, 2026, raising a total of US$800 million (approximately NT$25.2 billion). The zero-coupon bonds have a five-year maturity and a 0.00 % yield-to-maturity, with a conversion price of NT$550.13 per share - a 12.5% conversion premium based on the pricing-date closing price. The bonds are expected to be issued on September 29, 2026 and then listed on the Singapore Exchange. Use of proceeds not stated.
quarterly_data.figure: US$800 million (approximately NT$25.2 billion); conversion price NT$550.13 per share; conversion premium 12.5%
